cards.ex: I created a burner account to follow the drama without my real name attached to it.
cards.exUz: Drama kuzatish uchun asosiy ismimni bog'lamasdan, soxta akkaunt yaratdim.
cards.uzDef: Asosiy akkauntingiz bilan bog'liq bo'lmagan, vaqtinchalik ishlatiladigan akkaunt.

cards.ex: He thought he was dating a supermodel, but he was being catfished.
cards.exUz: U supermodel bilan uchrashayapman deb o'yladi, lekin u soxta shaxs tomonidan aldangan edi.
cards.uzDef: Internetda boshqa odamga soxta shaxsiy ma'lumotlar bilan o'zini ko'rsatish.

cards.ex: The digital divide is a major problem, leaving many people behind in the information age.
cards.exUz: Raqamli tafovut katta muammo, bu axborot asrida ko'p odamlarni ortda qoldirmoqda.
cards.uzDef: Internet va texnologiyalarga kirish imkoniyatidagi tengsizlik.

cards.ex: Doxing is a serious offense and can have devastating consequences for the victim.
cards.exUz: Doxing jiddiy huquqbuzarlik va jabrlanuvchi uchun halokatli oqibatlarga olib kelishi mumkin.
cards.uzDef: Shaxsning shaxsiy ma'lumotlarini internetda ruxsatsiz oshkor qilish.

cards.ex: I'm thinking of going off the grid for a week to disconnect and relax.
cards.exUz: Men bir hafta davomida ulanishni uzib, dam olish uchun tarmoqdan chiqishni o'ylayapman.
cards.uzDef: Internetdan, telefonlardan va boshqa aloqa vositalaridan vaqtinchalik voz kechish.

cards.ex: My handle online is usually something related to my favorite hobby.
cards.exUz: Mening onlayn taxallusim odatda sevimli mashg'ulotim bilan bog'liq.
cards.uzDef: Internetdagi platformalarda ishlatiladigan ism yoki taxallus.

cards.ex: Don't be a keyboard warrior; try to be respectful in your online interactions.
cards.exUz: Klaviatura jangchisi bo'lmang; onlayn munosabatlaringizda hurmatli bo'lishga harakat qiling.
cards.uzDef: Internetda bahsli yoki tajovuzkor bo'lgan odam.

cards.ex: That embarrassing moment from high school is still living rent-free in my head.
cards.exUz: O'rta maktabdagi o'sha uyatli lahza hali ham mening ongimda yashayapti.
cards.uzDef: Kimningdir fikrlari doimiy ravishda xayolingizda bo'lishi.

cards.ex: She's known for oversharing online, posting every detail of her life.
cards.exUz: U hayotining har bir tafsilotini joylashtirib, internetda ortiqcha ulashish bilan tanilgan.
cards.uzDef: Shaxsiy ma'lumotni internetda haddan tashqari ko'p oshkor qilish.

cards.ex: It's rude to phub someone when they're trying to have a conversation with you.
cards.exUz: Birov siz bilan suhbatlashishga harakat qilganda, telefonga ko'milib, unga e'tibor bermaslik odobsizlikdir.
cards.uzDef: Birov bilan gaplashayotganda unga e'tibor bermay, telefon bilan mashg'ul bo'lish.

cards.ex: I wouldn't download anything from that shady website; it looks like a scam.
cards.exUz: Men bu shubhali veb-saytdan hech narsa yuklamayman; u firibgarlikka o'xshaydi.
cards.uzDef: Ishonchsiz va havfli bo'lishi mumkin bo'lgan veb-sayt.

cards.ex: Allowing misinformation to spread online is a slippery slope towards losing trust in institutions.
cards.exUz: Onlaynda noto'g'ri ma'lumotlarning tarqalishiga yo'l qo'yish muassasalarga ishonchni yo'qotishga olib keladigan sirpanchiq yo'ldir.
cards.uzDef: Bir harakat boshqa salbiy oqibatlarga olib kelishi mumkin.

cards.ex: Some say that troll farms are the reason for so much negativity online.
cards.exUz: Ba'zilarning aytishicha, troll fermalari onlayndagi ko'plab negativliklarga sabab bo'ladi.
cards.uzDef: Soxta ma'lumot tarqatish uchun tashkil etilgan guruh.

cards.ex: I need to unsubscribe from all these marketing emails; my inbox is flooded.
cards.exUz: Men ushbu marketing elektron pochta xabarlarining barchasiga obunani bekor qilishim kerak; mening kirish qutim to'lib ketgan.
cards.uzDef: Elektron pochta xabarlarini olishni to'xtatish.

cards.ex: The app became popular virtually overnight after a celebrity endorsed it.
cards.exUz: Ilova mashhur shaxs uni qo'llab-quvvatlaganidan so'ng deyarli bir kechada mashhur bo'lib ketdi.
cards.uzDef: Juda tez va qisqa vaqt ichida sodir bo'lish.

cards.ex: They weaponize information to spread propaganda and influence public opinion.
cards.exUz: Ular tashviqot tarqatish va jamoatchilik fikrini o'zgartirish uchun ma'lumotlardan qurol sifatida foydalanadilar.
cards.uzDef: Ma'lumotni zarar yetkazish yoki manipulyatsiya qilish uchun ishlatish.

cards.ex: Algorithm bias can perpetuate discrimination if it's not carefully addressed.
cards.exUz: Algoritm xatoligi ehtiyotkorlik bilan hal qilinmasa, kamsitishni davom ettirishi mumkin.
cards.uzDef: Algoritmlarning adolatsiz natijalar berishi.

cards.ex: The digital divide widens as technology advances, leaving some behind.
cards.exUz: Texnologiya rivojlanishi bilan raqamli tafovut kengaymoqda, bu esa ba'zilarni ortda qoldirmoqda.
cards.uzDef: Internetdan foydalanish imkoniyatidagi farq ortib bormoqda.

cards.ex: Online echo chambers reinforce existing beliefs, making it harder to change minds.
cards.exUz: Onlayn aks sado xonalari mavjud e'tiqodlarni kuchaytiradi, bu fikrni o'zgartirishni qiyinlashtiradi.
cards.uzDef: Faqat o'z fikrlariga mos keladigan ma'lumotlarni oladigan guruhlar.

cards.ex: Many news organizations paywall content to generate revenue.
cards.exUz: Ko'pgina yangiliklar tashkilotlari daromad olish uchun pullik kontentni taqdim etadilar.
cards.uzDef: Faqat pul to'laganlarga mavjud bo'lgan kontent.

cards.ex: The internet has rendered many traditional forms of communication obsolete.
cards.exUz: Internet aloqaning ko'plab an'anaviy shakllarini eski holga keltirdi.
cards.uzDef: Yangi texnologiya tufayli keraksiz bo'lib qolish.

cards.ex: I'm experiencing social media fatigue, so I'm taking a break from it.
cards.exUz: Men ijtimoiy tarmoq charchog'ini his qilyapman, shuning uchun men undan tanaffus olyapman.
cards.uzDef: Ijtimoiy tarmoqlardan foydalanishdan kelib chiqadigan charchoq va zerikish.

cards.ex: It's important to be aware of how easily we can spread misinformation online.
cards.exUz: Onlaynda noto'g'ri ma'lumotni qanchalik oson tarqatishimiz mumkinligini bilish muhim.
cards.uzDef: Yolg'on yoki noto'g'ri ma'lumotni boshqalarga yetkazish.

cards.ex: They had to take down the offensive content after receiving complaints.
cards.exUz: Shikoyatlar kelib tushgandan so'ng ular haqoratli kontentni olib tashlashga majbur bo'lishdi.
cards.uzDef: Veb-saytdan yoki platformadan kontentni olib tashlash.

cards.ex: The anonymity of the internet can be a breeding ground for cyberbullying.
cards.exUz: Internetning anonimligi kiberbulling uchun qulay sharoit bo'lishi mumkin.
cards.uzDef: Nimaningdir rivojlanishi uchun qulay sharoit.

cards.ex: We need to engage in a civil discourse about the ethical implications of AI.
cards.exUz: Biz sun'iy intellektning axloqiy oqibatlari haqida madaniy munozaraga kirishishimiz kerak.
cards.uzDef: Biror masala bo'yicha fikr almashish.

cards.ex: The comments section of that article was a hive of activity after the controversial statement.
cards.exUz: O'sha maqolaning izohlar bo'limi bahsli bayonotdan keyin faoliyat markaziga aylandi.
cards.uzDef: Ko'p odamlar faol ishlaydigan joy.

cards.ex: The politician lost credibility after the scandal was exposed online.
cards.exUz: Siyosatchi internetda janjal fosh etilgandan so'ng ishonchni yo'qotdi.
cards.uzDef: Odamlar sizga ishonmay qo'yishi.

cards.ex: I disabled push notifications because they were too distracting.
cards.exUz: Chalg'ituvchi bo'lgani uchun bildirishnomalarni o'chirib qo'ydim.
cards.uzDef: Telefon ekranida paydo bo'ladigan xabarlar.

cards.ex: Social media platforms rely heavily on user-generated content.
cards.exUz: Ijtimoiy media platformalari asosan foydalanuvchilar yaratgan kontentga tayanadi.
cards.uzDef: Foydalanuvchilar yaratgan kontent.
